results.title: Filter also drops locationless diagnostics for local types
results.reason: Filter requires Location.IsInSource, so Location.None is dropped. Local case exists: positional record property syntax is ParameterSyntax, so GetPropertyIdentifierLocation returns null and the diagnostic disappears.

results.title: Third indexing site (line 735) not visibly fixed
results.reason: Branch forked from an old merge-base where this line is commented out (head:715). On origin/master line 735 is live, untouched by the diff, and still indexes [0] on the analyzer path.

results.title: Generator crash fix not explained by the diff
results.reason: Generator does pass null, but the MemberNeedsKey diagnostic is built unconditionally before ?.Invoke, so the edited [0] at line 1077 also explains the generator crash.

results.title: Analyzer coverage depends on what the verifier runs
results.reason: The verifier's GetDiagnosticAnalyzers returns every DiagnosticAnalyzer in the generator assembly, including MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer, so AD0001 is exercised.

results.title: Docs claim the defining assembly reports problems
results.reason: Docs say the defining assembly reports these issues, but that happens only if it was built with the analyzer. The consumer filter just drops them.

results.title: Unkeyed-member test asserts the silencing
results.reason: Test only asserts no warnings and resolver hint name exists; the MemberNeedsKey diagnostic for metadata member is dropped. Generated formatter contents never checked.
